hero.title: YOUR BRAND IN EVERY STREAM
hero.subtitle: An intimate gaming and IRL community that watches 2-4 hours a day. Not passive subscribers, but people who are actually in the room.

pitch: 279 subscribers. 5.9% CTR, above platform average. 4–5 streams a week, every week. The math works differently when every viewer chose to be here.

differentiator.title: THE TRUST ADVANTAGE
differentiator.body: Large channels sell reach. I sell trust. A community that shows up for 15 hours of live content per week builds a parasocial bond that passive subscribers never develop. When I integrate your brand, it lands like a recommendation from a friend, not an ad they skip.

pillars.label: NO SCRIPT READS
pillars.body: Every integration is written by me, in my voice, around what the product actually does. Your brand becomes content, not interruption.

pillars.label: TECHNICAL DEPTH
pillars.body: Electrical Engineering student. Full-stack developer. I built this site. For tech and gaming brands, I can actually demo, evaluate, and break down your product on camera.

pillars.label: MULTI-PLATFORM
pillars.body: Every stream runs simultaneously on YouTube and Twitch. Your placement reaches the same engaged audience across both platforms in a single session.

pillars.label: EARLY ADVANTAGE
pillars.body: Lock in a rate while the channel is growing. The brands that partner now are the ones the community associates with the come-up.

packages.name: STREAM MENTION
packages.deliverable: Verbal mention + on-screen brand placement during a 2–3 hour livestream on YouTube and Twitch. Link drops in chat and bio for 7 days.

packages.name: INTEGRATED SEGMENT
packages.deliverable: 60–90 second integrated segment inside an edited gameplay or vlog video. Custom written, brand-aligned, no script-read energy. Permanent on-channel.
packages.ideal: Products with a story to tell

packages.name: REVIEW + WRITEUP
packages.deliverable: Full dedicated review video plus an accompanying blog post. Built for tech and gaming brands who want depth and searchable, lasting content.

packages.name: CUSTOM
packages.deliverable: Multi-stream campaigns, series sponsorships, affiliate programs, product gifting. Built around your goals.
